title: RAD REX (Rampage-Style Beat-Em Up) - game made using claude code, and chatgpt for sprite work
author: Gigarabbit
selftext: started vibecoding my dream game not too long ago (not this one) its a variety genre game essentially, and i wanted to give each boss its own genre game as extra's, but to be honest. found this "extra's" game to feel fun enough, still including it to make the dream game to feel feature rich. but i figured id make a standalone version. planning on releasing it for free. its already recreated in roblox if you wanna play the neutered version. but here is the game running on unity2D

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/Gigarabbit, this falls under Rule 4. Sharing your game is okay here, free or paid, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).

replies.author: Gigarabbit
replies.body: Hey! Sooo, I’m still new too ai game dev, sorry if I don’t get the rules much. I used Claude as my code base, and ChatGPT astra 6.1 as my sprite sheet. I didn’t wanna reach out to any other subs because of “slop”., but I’ve had a passion for game development since I’ve been a child, being 38 now… man, I can’t believe it’s actually happening for me. Any other details I’ll dm.

replies.author: Gigarabbit
replies.body: I’ll try my best since I’m new, Claude code is my main base of code in of itself, and I’ve been using ChatGPT for pixel art, also some code when Claude’s limits have ran out, basically both platforms pointed at a unity2D project. It took 3 days or iteration after iteration to achieve the exact look and feel I’ve wanted.
